title: 第13章  有个退伍老兵？必须见见！
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
王冲抬眸望向窗外崭新的教学楼、开阔的操场，还有操场上那群青涩稚嫩、朝气蓬勃的学生，眼底不由得生出几分感慨。
年轻真好啊。
自从进入了部队，日常就是训练，训练，还是训练，接触不到外界，没有任何的信息干扰，脑子里只有部队的一切。
而现在，再次看到这一张张未经世事、干净纯粹的少年脸庞，听着耳边隐约传来的细碎嬉闹声，王冲心底忍不住轻叹。
这样的日子，已经一去不复返了。
随着军车停稳，一众军训教官依次下车，身姿挺拔、队列整齐，气场沉稳。
学校领导早早等候在场，上前一一接待、握手寒暄，简单对接了军训流程、纪律要求和安全事项，全程高效顺畅。
经过校方的统一分配，各位教官各自敲定负责的班级。
王冲领到的任务，正是全校最特殊的班级，复读班。
复读生压力大、备考任务重、心态复杂，不同于普通新生，军训需要把控分寸、耐心引导，算是比较费心的班级。
这个重任交给王冲也是有理由的。
这可是刘畅钦点的军训教官，经验十足啊！
对接工作结束后，一道清冷高挑的身影缓步走来。
一身简约正装，气质清冷脱俗，眉眼淡然，正是复读班班主任李舒婉。
她主动上前，对着王冲微微颔首，礼貌开口：“王班长，辛苦你对复读班的学生开展军训了。”
王冲端正站姿，礼貌回礼：“李老师客气了，配合学校完成军训任务，是我们的本职工作。”
“而且李老师你也可以放心，我会把握好训练尺度，兼顾训练质量和学生状态，顺利完成这次军训任务。”
李舒婉微微点头，随即想起什么，随口补充了一句：“对了，我们复读班情况特殊，班里还有一位比较特别的学生，是退伍回来的老兵。”
此话一出，王冲眼睛一亮，脸上当即露出喜色。
退伍老兵？

那可真是意外之喜！
他太清楚校园军训的难处了。
一群零基础的学生，队列松散、纪律薄弱、体能参差不齐，光是纠正动作、规整纪律、培养作风，就要耗费大量时间和精力，带起来格外费心。
班里若是有个退伍老兵，一切就不一样了。
对方懂纪律、知口令、熟队列，自带军人作风，不仅不用费心调教，还能帮忙带动班级、协助整队、纠正新生动作，妥妥的得力帮手！
这就跟老班长发现下连的新兵里有个二次入伍的老兵一样，练新兵这种事情，完全可以交给老兵来，自己偷懒就行，光是想想就美滋滋！
此刻的王冲满心欢喜，只觉得捡到了宝一样。
这次的军训，真是来对了！
等明天，必须见见这个退伍老兵。
第二天清晨，六点整。
宿舍刺耳的起床铃声准时炸响，穿透整栋宿舍楼。
铃声响起的瞬间，林毅双眼已然睁开。
他翻身下床，动作干脆利落，行云流水。
铺床、抻平床单、掐角压线、叠被，整套内务那套流程倍儿熟。
短短几十秒就搞定了。
反观四零二宿舍另外五个舍友，完全是两个极端。
几人都是从没经历过军训的普通学生，被铃声猛地惊醒，一个个睡眼惺忪、手忙脚乱，迷迷糊糊爬下床。
被子胡乱一团，乱糟糟挤作一团。
有的人床单皱成一团，有的人被子歪歪扭扭。
他们本来想要起身就走的，但看着老大哥林毅已经整理好内务了，还以为必须要整理内务，一个个也学着开始整理。

但他们整理内务的水平……可以说是一窍不通，给狗挂块饼，狗做的都比他们强。
林毅收拾妥当，靠在床边等了半天，看着几个小家伙笨拙慌乱的样子，属实有点看不下去。
他无奈摇了摇头，一脸哭笑不得。
“行了行了，都让开。”
林毅上前一步，主动接手，耐心手把手教学。
他一步步示范，教几人怎么抻床单、怎么压被痕、怎么掐出棱角，细致讲解内务标准和小技巧。
在他的手把手指导下，五个舍友总算慢慢摸清门道，勉强把床铺收拾得像模像样。
几人看着规整的床铺，纷纷长舒一口气，看向林毅的眼神满是感激。
“毅哥，太谢谢你了！没有你我们今天内务直接完蛋！”
“不愧是退伍老兵，也太专业了！”
林毅摆了摆手，刚想说没事，余光扫过墙上的挂钟，瞳孔微微一缩。
坏了，耽误太久了。
现在已经错过集合时间了！
“别愣着了，快！迟到了！”
林毅话音落下，几人当即慌了神，不敢多耽误一秒，抓起帽子，踩着鞋子，一溜烟冲出宿舍，朝着操场狂奔而去。
此刻的操场上，复读班学生早已全员列队站好。
队伍整齐划一，鸦雀无声，所有人身姿端正，静静等候军训开始。
队伍正前方，王冲一身笔挺作训服，双手背在身后，身姿挺拔如松，整张脸黑得吓人，满眼的怒火。
他早早就位整队，再三强调过军训纪律、集合时间，结果偏偏有人顶风作案，第一天就迟到。
寂静的操场上，回荡着王冲的冷厉声：“我带过无数批次军训，见过拖沓的、偷懒的，唯独没见过军训第一天就敢迟到的！”

这是他第一次带军训，但也决不能表现出来，不然这帮学生只会当他是个新教官蛋子，不利于立威。
来之前，刘班长还跟他说过，一定要立威。
他再次骂道：“无组织！无纪律！眼里没有集体，没有规矩！”
他声音铿锵有力，狠狠砸在所有人耳边。
列队的复读生们个个噤若寒蝉，没人敢抬头对视，更没人敢出声反驳，全场安静得落针可闻。
队伍里有人低着头，小声无奈地嘀咕。
“真是服了，谁啊第一天就迟到，害得我们全班一起挨骂。”
“太没集体意识了，本来第一天军训就紧张，这下更惨了。”
所有人心里都憋着一股郁闷，平白无故被迟到的人连带受罚挨训。
王冲目光冷冽地扫过全场，当众立下铁律：“从今天开始，我立下规矩！”
“但凡后续有人迟到、拖沓、违反军训纪律，一律加倍训练！别人练一遍，你就练两遍！别人休息，你继续加练！”
“军训，训的就是纪律！没有规矩不成方圆，敢无视规矩，就必须严惩！”
话音落下，操场上的气氛愈发凝重，所有人都绷紧了神经，不敢有半点松懈。
“教官，他们……他们来了……”
content_en:
Wang Chong raised his eyes and looked out the window at the brand new teaching building, the open playground, and the group of young and energetic students on the playground, and he couldn't help but feel a bit of emotion in his eyes.
It's great to be young.
Since joining the army, my daily routine has been training, training, and training. I have no contact with the outside world and no information interference. I only have everything in my mind about the army.
But now, seeing the innocent, pure young faces again, and listening to the faint sounds of play in his ears, Wang Chong couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
Those days are gone forever.
As the military vehicle came to a stop, a group of military training instructors got out of the car one after another, with tall and straight postures, neat lines, and a calm aura.
The school leaders were waiting at the scene early and came forward to receive them one by one, shake hands and exchange greetings, and briefly explained the military training procedures, disciplinary requirements and safety matters, making the whole process efficient and smooth.
After unified allocation by the school, each instructor determined the class he was responsible for.
The task Wang Chong received was the most special class in the school, the repeat class.
Repeating students are under great pressure, have heavy exam preparation tasks, and have complicated mentalities. Unlike ordinary freshmen, military training requires careful control and patient guidance, which is considered a relatively troublesome class.
There is a reason why this important task is given to Wang Chong.
This is the military training instructor appointed by Liu Chang, he is very experienced!
After the docking work was completed, a cold and tall figure walked slowly over.
Dressed in simple formal attire, with a cool and refined temperament, and calm eyebrows, he is Li Shuwan, the head teacher of the repeat class.
She took the initiative to step forward, nodded slightly to Wang Chong, and said politely: "Squad leader Wang, thank you for carrying out military training for the students in the repeat class."
Wang Chong stood upright and responded politely: "Teacher Li, you are so polite. It is our duty to cooperate with the school in completing military training tasks."
"And Teacher Li, you can rest assured that I will grasp the training scale, take into account the training quality and the students' status, and successfully complete this military training mission."
Li Shuwan nodded slightly, then thought of something and added casually: "By the way, our repeat class is in a special situation. There is also a special student in the class who is a veteran who has returned from the army."
As soon as these words came out, Wang Chong's eyes lit up and his face immediately showed joy.
Veteran?
What a surprise!
He knows all too well the difficulties of campus military training.
A group of students with no basic knowledge have loose formation, weak discipline, and uneven physical fitness. Just correcting movements, regulating discipline, and cultivating styles will take a lot of time and energy, and it is particularly troublesome to bring them up.
If there is a veteran in the class, everything will be different.
The other party understands disciplines, knows commands, is familiar with formation, and has a military style. Not only does he not have to worry about training, but he can also help lead the class, assist in team formation, and correct the new students' movements. He is a perfect helper!
This is just like the old squad leader discovering that among the recruits in the lower company there is a veteran who has joined the army for the second time. Training of new recruits can be left to the veterans, and he can just be lazy. Just thinking about it makes him happy!
At this moment, Wang Chong was filled with joy, as if he had found a treasure.
This military training is really at the right time!
Waiting for tomorrow, I must meet this veteran.
The next morning, six o'clock sharp.
The harsh wake-up bell in the dormitory rang on time, penetrating the entire dormitory building.
The moment the bell rang, Ji Yi's eyes opened.
He rolled out of bed, his movements crisp and smooth.
Making the bed, straightening the sheets, cutting corners and crimping, and folding quilts, the whole housekeeping process is very familiar.
It's done in just a few dozen seconds.
On the other hand, the other five roommates in dormitory 402 were completely at two extremes.
Several of them were ordinary students who had never experienced military training. They were suddenly awakened by the ringing of the bell. They all crawled out of bed blearily and in a hurry.
The quilt was a mess, a mess and a huddle.
Some people's sheets are wrinkled, and some people's quilts are crooked.
They originally wanted to get up and leave, but seeing that big brother Lin Yi had alreadyAfter tidying up the housework, I thought it was necessary to tidy up the housework, so one by one I also learned to start tidying up.
But their level of housekeeping... can be said to be completely clueless. If you hang a cake for a dog, the dog can do it better than them.
Ji Yi packed up and waited by the bed for a long time. He couldn't bear to see the clumsy and flustered little guys.
He shook his head helplessly, looking dumbfounded.
"Okay, okay, everyone, get out of the way."
Lin Yi stepped forward, took the initiative, and taught patiently.
He demonstrated step by step, teaching several people how to stretch the sheets, how to press the quilt marks, how to pinch out the edges, and explained housekeeping standards and tips in detail.
Under his step-by-step guidance, the five roommates finally figured out the ropes and managed to make the bed decently.
Several people looked at the regular bed and breathed a long sigh of relief. Their eyes looked at Ji Yi with gratitude.
"Brother Yi, thank you so much! Without you, our internal affairs would be completely finished today!"
"As expected of a veteran, he is also very professional!"
Ji Yi waved his hand, and just about to say it was okay, his peripheral vision glanced at the clock on the wall, and his pupils shrank slightly.
Broken, it took too long.
The meeting time has now been missed!
"Stop hanging around, hurry up! You're late!"
After Lin Yi finished speaking, several people immediately panicked. Not daring to waste another second, they grabbed their hats, stepped on their shoes, rushed out of the dormitory, and ran towards the playground.
On the playground at this moment, all the students in the repeat class have already lined up.
The team was uniform and silent, and everyone was in good posture, quietly waiting for the military training to begin.
Right in front of the team, Wang Chong was wearing a straight training uniform, with his hands behind his back, his body as tall as a pine tree, his face was frighteningly dark, and his eyes were full of anger.
He assembled the team early and repeatedly emphasized military training disciplines and assembly times. However, someone committed a crime and was late on the first day.
The silent playground echoed with Wang Chong's cold and stern voice: "I have led countless batches of military training. I have seen procrastination and laziness, but I have never seen anyone dare to be late on the first day of military training!"
This was his first time leading military training, but he must not show it, otherwise the students would just think he was a new instructor, which would not be conducive to establishing his authority.
Before coming, Squad Leader Liu also told him that he must establish his authority.
He cursed again: "No organization! No discipline! There is no collective and no rules in the eyes!"
His voice was sonorous and powerful, hitting everyone's ears hard.
The repeat students who lined up were all silent. No one dared to raise their heads and look at each other, and no one dared to refute. The whole place was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.
Some people in the team lowered their heads and muttered helplessly.
"I'm really convinced. Who is late on the first day? The whole class got scolded."
"There is so little collective consciousness. I was already nervous on the first day of military training, but now it's even worse."
Everyone felt depressed, being punished and scolded for being late for no reason.
Wang Chong swept the entire audience with cold eyes and set an iron rule in public: "From today on, I will set the rules!"
"If anyone is late, procrastinates, or violates military training disciplines later on, we will train twice as much! If others practice once, you practice twice! If others take a break, you continue to practice more!"
"Military training is about discipline! There is no rule without rules. If you dare to ignore the rules, you must be severely punished!"
After the words fell, the atmosphere on the playground became more solemn. Everyone tensed up and did not dare to relax at all.
"Instructor, they...they are coming..."
